history_pixels_sha256.declared_rule: Exact H7 history equality entails exact equality of both its initial and query frames; direct zero overlap for either endpoint excludes exact history equality.

evidence.evidence: Every original train frame was directly compared with every candidate initial/query-frame hash. Exact H7 history equality would require exact equality of those history endpoints.

visible_payload_sha256.declared_rule: The label-free visible payload is exactly the canonical hash of history, query, action, and H1-target hashes; exact payload content equality entails exact history and H1-target content equality.

evidence.evidence: The visible payload contains only history, query, action, and H1-target hashes. Exact payload content equality entails exact history and H1-target equality, both excluded above.
